name: 404 Designer
author: Hamza Mairaj

sections.description:
The 404 Designer plugin allows you to design a custom 404 error page using any WordPress page builder (such as Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, or Gutenberg) and set that page as your site’s 404 template.

Instead of using a generic and bland 404 error page, you can now use your creativity to design an engaging and user-friendly page to guide visitors when they land on non-existent or broken links. Simply design a page like you would for any other page on your site, and select it from the plugin’s settings page to set it as your custom 404 page.

How It Works:

  • Design Your 404 Page: Create a custom page using any page builder or WordPress editor.
  • Set It As the 404 Page: In the plugin’s settings, select the page you’ve created and save the settings.
  • Enjoy Your New 404 Page: When visitors land on a broken or non-existent URL, they will see your beautifully designed custom 404 page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/404-designer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Settings > 404 Designer page in the WordPress admin to select your custom 404 page.
sections.faq:
Which page builders are compatible with this plugin?

The plugin is compatible with all major page builders, including:

Elementor
Gutenberg
Beaver Builder
Divi Builder
WPBakery Page Builder
And more.

How do I set my custom 404 page?

After activating the plugin, go to Settings > 404 Designer and search for the page you designed. Select it from the dropdown and save the changes. That’s it!

Does this plugin work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all WordPress themes.

What if I want to use a different page as my 404 template later?

You can change the 404 template at any time by going back to the plugin’s settings and selecting a different page.
